title: Reading Drill — A trial of reusable name badges — Building a comparison
description: One short passage, six questions. Recommended time: 10 minutes.

passages.title: A trial of reusable name badges — Building a comparison
passages.body:
**A** The event coordinator had been asked to investigate badges being thrown away when an event ends in Brackenton. Its first task was to decide which signs of improvement could be compared between sites. It settled on badge return rate, because the same measure could be applied in the original setting and at a second location.

**B** During a seven-week comparison, the team used check-in records at both places. It recorded outcomes separately for each site. Because different closing times might influence the figures, the team used a column in the record to show when that condition was present. The surveys included quiet periods as well as busy ones.

**C** The team then put forward a collection point near the exit. Its report asked for another comparison after the change had been tried. This would distinguish a genuine effect from an improvement that could have occurred anyway. The report did not assume that the more successful site before the change would be the better site afterwards.
